name: Take-Profit/Stop-Loss-Rechner
description: Enter your entry price, leverage, and margin to instantly calculate PnL for up to 3 take-profit levels and a stop loss. Shows Risk:Reward ratio and estimated liquidation price. Works for both long and short positions.
metaDescription: Einstiegspreis und Risikoparameter eingeben und Take-Profit (TP) und Stop-Loss (SL) Preisniveaus mit Risiko-Ertrags-Verhältnis berechnen.
